text:
Evelyn Hart: Quick thread for roadmap sync: enterprise prospect asks for 6-year audit archives, searchable subsets, and tenant-controlled keys. We need a clear MVP split and a launch decision by Wed.

Marco Ruiz: Proposal: MVP = legal_hold API + cold immutable archive (WORM) + manifest signing + BYOK plumbing (optional). Searchable cold index is a paid opt-in pilot.

Yvonne Lee: Legal note: any archive used for SOC2/ISO must be provably complete. No sampling for e-discovery. Removal of legal_hold must be an auditable two-step process with Legal signoff.

Marco Ruiz: Cost/ops note: keeping full indices for 6y is ~+1.1 USD/user-month; cold-object-only with manifests is ~+0.22 USD/user-month. Rehydrate path costs are variable; estimate subset restore ~3-5 USD/GB, full reindex depends on size.

Evelyn Hart: Can we define conservative default profiles and an opt-in for heavy e-discovery clients? Something like: default 90d hot, 1y metadata, 0 cold; enterprise-archive: 365d hot, 2y indexed, 6y cold (manifest + BYOK).

Marco Ruiz: Config prototype (RFC-friendly):
```yaml
archive_profiles:
  default:
    hot_days: 90
    metadata_years: 1
    cold_years: 0
  enterprise_archive:
    hot_days: 365
    indexed_years: 2
    cold_years: 6
    byok_supported: true
    legal_hold_enforced: true
    searchable_cold: false
```

Yvonne Lee: Add requirement: legal_hold overrides TTL and records an immutable event including actor, timestamp, reason, and case_id. Exports of event history must be signed and paginated.

SecOpsBot: [system] Retention draft detected by Marco Ruiz  running compliance checks.

Marco Ruiz: Ops checklist for MVP: BYOK wrap/unwrap + escrow log, manifest signer (SHA256 + timestamp), WORM storage class, legal_hold API, restore runbook (subset SLA target 3h, partial reindex 24h, full reindex 36-72h). Need signoff from Security + Legal before we commit.

Evelyn Hart: Decision for roadmap: ship MVP with BYOK optional and searchable-cold as Q4 pilot. Legal wants BYOK required for >5y at GA. Anyone object?

Yvonne Lee: No objection. Please include the legal removal flow and export signing in the SOC2 playbook PR.

Marco Ruiz: I'll open the RFC with cost sims and attach the YAML example.

Evelyn Hart: Thanks  I'll add this as "Audit archive MVP (WORM + BYOK + legal_hold)" on the board and tag Marco/Yvonne as owners.
